contract_requirements_agreed_with_worker: RequestAp returns accepted/pending, never applied just because queued; one management request accepted at a time. Same already-ready config/profile has a named idempotent terminal; another pending AP may be busy-rejected without pretending accepted.

Every accepted request has one terminal outcome. OFF can supersede a still-pending/running AP but may not rewrite an already failed/quarantined result. Late SDK return is recorded separately, not a second terminal or proof a newer epoch applied.

OFF is logical output-gate only, radio state unknown. It must preserve active old-epoch SDK phase/start/deadline/held owner. New AP cannot bypass a still-owned backend or sticky quarantine via OFF->AP.

CAPS2 capability means software support only. Request ACK, terminal and query carry the real scientific boot/session hook plus Wi-Fi epoch; no second session identity or silent unknown boot0. Query one explicit request per bounded reply; missing/evicted result is unknown/expired, not substituted latest.

Terminal may precede or follow ACK/data in transport. Cache last two results plus active request and query without side effects; preserve publication admitted versus ESP_OK no-sink no-op via PublishLifecycleObserved. Any retry and optional ACK-commit wait must be finite.

wifiSent legacy counters advance only after real full-length SDK return. queued, SDK accepted, timeout/quarantine, partial/error and peer receipt remain distinct. A late full return can update accepted evidence once but never resume a quarantined owner.

memory_and_startup.layout: Two2304 normal + one2304 lifecycle + one512 CTRL; single PSRAM|8BIT allocation no internal fallback. Larger than earlier5632 candidate to preserve existing public2304 lifecycle contract. No pool reallocation or payload free while owner unknown.
memory_and_startup.stack: Proposed new owner4096B internal stack/TCB plus existing wifiCtrl4096B and Wi-Fi SDK allocations; actual largest internal block and stack watermark still require target validation. DefaultOFF performs software state registration only.
memory_and_startup.root_gate: Two atomic completed bits: Core0 output/USB-sink reservation path terminal; Core1 sensorarrayInitSystem returned, including early failure. Release once when both bits observed. scan-task creation failure marks both because neither later path runs. This is attempt-path completion, not READY, success of every resource, physical safety or absence of later unrelated heap allocation.
memory_and_startup.late_SPI: BootSpiStart has one startup call site and allocates its6144B dynamic stack synchronously before returning. The probe task persists even after lateDONE/timeout. InitSystem return therefore ends that creation attempt without proving the SPI owner stopped; gate does not alter its quarantine or READY.

new_existing_P1_identified_for_owner_fix.exact_SDK: wifi_default.c:404-412 asserts esp_netif_new result and uses ESP_ERROR_CHECK for attach and default handler registration. sdkconfig enables assertions and panic reboot.
new_existing_P1_identified_for_owner_fix.impact: Moving this convenience call to an isolated owner does not stop allocation/attach/registration failure from aborting the entire firmware. Current post-call NULL check cannot catch the assertion.
new_existing_P1_identified_for_owner_fix.required_minimum: Use public ESP_NETIF_DEFAULT_WIFI_AP + esp_netif_new + esp_netif_attach_wifi_ap + esp_wifi_set_default_wifi_ap_handlers inside guarded owner, checking each result without SDK edits. Preserve partial stage ownership; attach may already store a global netif pointer before failing. Do not treat void destroy helper as verified cleanup; unproven release requires retained state/quarantine.
new_existing_P1_identified_for_owner_fix.tests_required: Actual owner host injection for NULL netif, attach failure, handler registration failure, cleanup error/blocked cleanup; no abort, no freeing uncertain objects, first error retained. Still NOT_RUN for future owner.

event_callback_scope: Application WIFI event callback only records bounded state/epoch/reconciliation-needed under mux; no SDK calls or logging. SDK default AP handlers themselves still invoke driver/netif APIs on esp_event. Do not claim all SDK events are moved into the application owner. Backend applied means required application stages returned successfully and epoch matched, not station/PC connectivity.

restart_verified_boundary.actual_chain: main PerformManualRestart caches restarting intent and waits20ms for local publication; UsbOtgRestart calls PrepareRestart(total250ms). Only failed Prepare triggers existing emergency digital core reset. Successful Prepare enters esp_restart, which synchronously invokes registered shutdown handlers before esp_restart_noos. Default Wi-Fi handler is esp_wifi_stop (wifi_default.c:273).
restart_verified_boundary.limitation: A stuck Wi-Fi shutdown handler can prevent reaching noos and prevent falling back after Prepare success. Neither ACK/RAPP nor owner host tests prove a physical reset or USB reenumeration.
restart_verified_boundary.decision: Keep recovery limitation explicit and quarantine sticky; no automatic restart loop or unreviewed private reset bypass. Any later direct use of the existing S3 digital core-reset route for Wi-Fi quarantine needs separate source/IRAM/boot-latch/actual enumeration validation.

remaining_gate: Full owner facade, request/terminal query, observer, deep-copy ownership, cleanup and no-abort implementation is not independently frozen/reviewed yet. Wi-Fi HIL NOT_RUN; project-wide P0/P1 closure not claimed.
